title: Secret US Air Force plane landed without Brazilian authorization
summary: James Fox tells of Secret US Air Force plane landed without Brazilian authorization, about 1996 at Varginha, Brazil, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Because they landed without the authorization of the Brazilian government. It was a secret mission and it was a US Air Force plane.

plain: James Fox, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, recounts what he was told about Varginha, a town in Brazil where people say a strange creature was captured in 1996. According to his source, a US Air Force plane landed there on a secret mission without permission from the Brazilian government. If true, it would suggest the United States quietly took part in whatever happened at Varginha.
